title: 信息日报 2026-09-21

headline.title: 中美经贸磋商在纽约举行 双方就人工智能问题举行对话
headline.summary: 9月20日，中国国务院副总理何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔在纽约举行中美经贸磋商。双方围绕落实历次磋商共识、促进双边贸易投资等议题进行交流，并专门就人工智能相关问题举行对话。磋商被描述为坦诚、深入且富有建设性。
headline.title_en: China, US Hold Trade Talks in New York, With Dialogue on AI
headline.summary_en: On September 20, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer in New York for China-US trade talks. The two sides discussed implementing previous consensus and boosting bilateral trade and investment, and held a dedicated dialogue on artificial intelligence. The talks were described as candid, in-depth and constructive.
headline.original_title: 中美经贸磋商在美国纽约举行
headline.reason: 作为头条，因为中美经贸磋商直接牵动全球市场与双边关系，且此次专门就人工智能问题举行对话，横跨中国观察、国际事务与财经版面，是当日最具综合影响力的新闻。
headline.reason_en: It is the lead item because the US-China trade talks directly affect global markets and bilateral relations, and the dedicated dialogue on AI spans China Watch, World Affairs and Finance, making it the day's most consequential story.
